name: azure-resource-manager-mysql-dotnet
summary: 参考 Microsoft 的 C# 示例，通过 Azure Resource Manager 管理 Azure Database for MySQL 灵活服务器。指南从添加 Azure.ResourceManager.MySql 和 Azure.Identity 包入手，演示如何在 .NET 中管理按 IP 地址范围设置的防火墙规则、服务器配置和 Microsoft Entra ID 管理员。示例仅适用于 Azure MySQL 灵活服务器。

Use Microsoft’s C# examples to manage Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server through Azure Resource Manager. The guide starts with the Azure.ResourceManager.MySql and Azure.Identity packages and shows how to work with IP-range firewall rules, server settings, and Microsoft Entra ID administrators from .NET. The examples are specific to Azure MySQL Flexible Server.
